sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

You emphasise proving your reliability, yet your proposed quality commitment allows more defects than your recorded performance—it seems there is room to translate that partnership ambition into stronger accountability. We want lasting quality improvement with proportionate financial consequences, not penalties that undermine your ability to deliver. How can you support a tighter, binding ppm commitment with a corrective-action report showing how that improvement will be achieved?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Your quality over the last 12 months was 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3). Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08). Our demand forecast for Bearing bracket HN is up +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09). We understand cash flow matters to you: we will pay every invoice reliably on the agreed day. Please send us your 8D report and a binding ppm commitment.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (800 ppm, EUR 150 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit; 800 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
